summary: Apply algFormRep_iota to groupLift(ϑ, s), whose reduction is diag(s, 1): all blocks l ≥ 1 are identities.

steps.claim: Let g = firstBlockHom(s): diag(s_x, 1) at the chosen places and 1 at the places of Q.
steps.lean: let g := firstBlockHom (D.levelPlaces ϑ) (@BlockIndex.firstBlock _ (Fin D.t) D.m) s

steps.claim: Outside block 0 (blockNumber ≠ 0), g_x has the entries of the identity (extendGL_spec).
steps.lean:
have e {x a b} (h : blockNumber .. ≠ 0) : g x a b = ite _ 1 0 :=
    x.rec (fun _ ↦ (extendGL_spec ..).2 a (by rwa [← blockNumber_eq_zero]) b) (by tauto)

simpa [show ∀ x l, (g x).1.toSquareBlock (blockNumber _) (.succ l) = 1 by simp_all [← ext_iff,
            toSquareBlock_def]] using! (algFormRep_iota ϑ s y _ _ (reduceFamily_liftResidue g) (by
    grind only [BlockTriangular]) fun _ ↦ (extendGL_spec ..).1).symm

steps.claim: Every diagonal block of g_x of level l + 1 ≥ 1 is the identity.
steps.lean:
show ∀ x l, (g x).1.toSquareBlock (blockNumber _) (.succ l) = 1 by simp_all [← ext_iff,
            toSquareBlock_def]]

steps.claim: algFormRep_iota for k = groupLift(ϑ, s) (its reduction is g, reduceFamily_liftResidue), g block triangular and block 0 equal to s: the character factor is 1, so ι(s·y) = groupLift(ϑ, s)·ι(y).
steps.lean:
using! (algFormRep_iota ϑ s y _ _ (reduceFamily_liftResidue g) (by
    grind only [BlockTriangular]) fun _ ↦ (extendGL_spec ..).1).symm
